appName: Jungle Zoo Ocean Passthrough Handtracking Demo
displayName: Jungle Zoo Ocean Passthrough Handtracking Demo
display_name: Jungle Zoo Ocean Passthrough Handtracking Demo
display_long_description:
Create a Jungle, Zoo, and Ocean in your home with Passthrough mixed reality and optional hand tracking.

This is a demo of "Jungle Zoo Ocean Passthrough Handtracking"
- in this demo there are 45 second round limits, there is no timer in the full version (search the store for the exact full name to find it)
- Featuring the best of “Jungle Passthrough”, “Ocean Passthrough”, “ZOSU Zoo Home Passthrough” with improvements.

There are over 60 animals, 100 sea creatures, and 70 plants to move, spawn, and delete.

There are over 30 premade areas or you can start from an empty scene. Animals and plants can be spawned randomly, or select animals to copy or enlarge in 3 bonus experimental levels.

Animals include: lions, tigers, bears, dinosaurs, wolves, elephants, rhinos, crocodiles, chickens, sharks, octopus, whales, dolphins, horses, cats, dogs, star fish, leopards, cuttle fish, zebras, owls, seals, lion fish, lizards, goats, sun fish, and many more.
